text: With a normal LP ruling out infectious meningitis or encephalitis, and JC virus PCR being negative, the clinical picture of cognitive decline, motor deficits, and non-enhancing white matter lesions in an advanced HIV patient strongly suggests HIV-associated neurocognitive disorder (HAND) or HIV encephalopathy.
